description: This file defines the LeaveEventSubscriber class in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It subscribes to leave-related events (apply, assign, approve, cancel, reject) and sends email notifications accordingly. The class manages event handling and email notification logic, utilizing an external EmailService.

classes.name: LeaveEventSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber that listens to leave-related events such as apply, assign, approve, cancel, and reject, and triggers email notifications accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping leave events to handler methods for subscription.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmailService used for sending notifications.

methods.name: onAllocateEvent
methods.description: Handles leave allocation events (apply and assign) by determining the type and sending appropriate email notifications.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles leave status change events (approve, cancel, reject) and triggers email notifications accordingly.
